newsitem.title: GERMANY: Leftists disrupt Republican rally in Berlin.
newsitem.headline: Leftists disrupt Republican rally in Berlin.

text.p: Left-wing demonstrators tried to disrupt a rally by Germany's far-right Republican party at Berlin's Brandenburg Gate on Saturday and police said nine people were detained after a series of clashes.
About 600 people from the far-right party gathered at Berlin's most famous landmark that stands where the Berlin Wall once divided the city.
Calling it the "day of national unity," the Republicans were recalling the June 17, 1953 uprising against communism in East Germany that was ultimately crushed by Soviet tanks.

As the Republicans emerged from their buses at Brandenburg gate, a group of about 500 leftists shouted "Nazis out" from behind police barricades. They blew whistles and sirens in an attempt to disrupt the rally.
Police said there were several altercations between police and demonstrators as the Republicans later tried to leave in their buses.
